title: The Unsaid Blue Hour
author: Kestrel Coldharbour
blurb: Elodie Thackeray, a night librarian in a city that sleeps less every year, keeps a careful inventory of everything unsaid. Then a childhood home goes up for auction — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must return to the place where the story went wrong, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
